description: Read-only analysis tools over the platform API. Same definitions are served by mcp_server.py (MCP) and used by ai_report.py (Anthropic Messages API tool use). The model only ever sees aggregates that already passed k-anonymity and the caller's scope.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Returns the scoring model: dimensions, pillars, weights, norms, thresholds and interpretation notes. Call this first so every number you report is interpreted correctly.

tools.name: list_waves
tools.description: Lists survey waves (rounds) with response counts and exclusions.

tools.name: list_units
tools.description: Lists units of one level (system, region, school, class, teacher) visible to the API key, sorted by index, with index, interval, tier and pillars. Optional tier filter: 2, 1, 0, -1, -2, na.

wave.description: Wave id; omit for the latest

tools.name: get_unit
tools.description: Full result for one unit: every dimension with raw mean, shrunk score, 90% interval, role breakdown, absolute band; pillars; index with tier and rank range; indicators (shares of tutoring to keep up, vacation tasks, behaviour notes, bullying, recess removal); participation.

tools.name: get_equity
tools.description: Gaps between boys and girls and between strong and struggling pupils (by reported grades) for each dimension, only where every group has at least 5 respondents. 'flagged' means the gap is at least 10 points and unlikely to be chance.

tools.name: get_trend
tools.description: Index and dimension scores of one unit across all waves.

tools.name: compare_units
tools.description: Dimension-by-dimension difference between unit a and unit b (or the system average when b is omitted). clear_difference = the 90% intervals do not overlap.

b.description: Omit to compare with the system average

tools.name: get_text_themes
tools.description: Counts of themes mentioned in redacted free-text answers for a school, region or the system (never the texts themselves). Empty below 10 respondents with text.
